# Code of Conduct

This is a small fan project. Be kind, assume good faith, and keep discussion about the tool and the
game. Harassment, insults, and discrimination are not welcome in issues, pull requests, or anywhere
else the project is discussed.

Unacceptable behavior includes personal attacks, trolling, publishing someone's private information,
and anything else that would make a reasonable person feel unwelcome.

The maintainer may edit, hide, or remove comments, issues, and pull requests that break these rules,
and may block repeat offenders. To report a problem, contact the maintainer
([@alepocalypse](https://github.com/alepocalypse)) through their GitHub profile.

This policy is adapted in spirit from the
[Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/).
